_comment: Porter MCP server for Tabnine (CLI + IDE agent). HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into .tabnine/agent/settings.json (project-level) or the global settings.json. Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token. IMPORTANT: Tabnine requires a RESTART (not just reload) to pick up MCP config changes. UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Tabnine install here.
